label: EXPLORATORY_PILOT
research_question: Do funding-conditioned realized-volatility features (causal at forecast origin t) predict modeled liquidation-boundary breaches within horizon H, beyond an RV-only baseline?

outcome.source: Track B modeled breach labels (trackb_breach_labels_20261118T093031Z), month 2024-04, 5 instruments, L in {5,10,20} x side {long,short} x H in {4h,24h}, mmr=0.005, entry at close of bar t (known at t), evaluation on hourly mark path t+1..t+H
outcome.unit: one scenario-row = instrument x entry-origin x leverage x side x horizon

data.feature_source: read-only ZIP/CSV dir twins under research_state/data_cache/ (markPriceKlines 1h + fundingRate), no network
data.entry_origin_rule: entry at close of bar t; features use only data available no later than bar t close (causal); trailing RV windows end at bar t; funding = latest observation with calc_time <= bar t close
data.note: single labeled month (2024-04); two chronological train/test splits within it. PILOT due to single-month label coverage; not confirmatory.

definitions.lrv1: sum of squared 1h mark-price log returns over trailing 1 hour ending at bar t
definitions.lrv24: sum of squared 1h mark-price log returns over trailing 24 hours ending at bar t
definitions.lrv168: sum of squared 1h mark-price log returns over trailing 168 hours ending at bar t
definitions.fund: signed latest funding rate with calc_time <= bar t close
definitions.fmean: mean of signed funding observations strictly before bar t (funding history trail)
definitions.fewma: EWMA of signed funding observations strictly before bar t, alpha=2/(min(n,168)+1)

features.standardization: train-only mean/std per split; zero-variance columns set std=1; missing features remain missing (no zero/forward fill)

model_family.type: drift-free logistic-type score, stdlib fit (IRLS, fixed ridge lambda=1e-6, max 100 iters, tol 1e-8, seed 12345)

metrics: precision@k (alert budget k=top 5% of test rows by predicted probability)
calibration (decile mean predicted vs observed breach rate)
contrasts: per scenario (L x side x H) AUC and precision@k
evaluation.uncertainty: block bootstrap over UTC-day test blocks, jointly across instruments, seed 12345, 500 reps, CI95 percentile
evaluation.baseline_comparison: paired test origins identical across B0 and B1; same eligible rows

materiality_floor: Delta AUC >= +0.01 (funding-conditioned over RV-only) on the pooled OOS test set, with CI95 lower bound > 0, to be considered materially informative; EXPLORATORY/PILOT only, no forecast-gate pass claim
multiplicity: all tested scenarios (3 L x 2 side x 2 H = 12) x 2 splits x 2 metrics are in the declared family; report raw and Holm-adjusted where claimed
sealed_months: none touched; 2024-04 label data is the Track B completed cache (pilot), not re-scored confirmatory
